text:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — noticed the warning hierarchy in the key rotate modal feels wrong when the user only changes metadata (name/role). Pasting Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/keyflow-rotate
Samir Patel: Agree. Right now the big red banner shows even if the old key stays active. Shouldn’t be primary danger unless we actually revoke the old key.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility note: the banner is visually first but focus lands on the primary CTA. Screen readers announce the modal title but not the banner. We should add an aria-live region for critical warnings.
Kevin Liu: Backend perspective — rotation endpoint returns {"rotated": true, "old_key_revoked": false}. We could expose a `revoke_old_key` toggle in the UI and default it off. Example response: ```json
{
  "key_id": "k_abcdef",
  "rotated": true,
  "old_key_revoked": false
}
```
Aria Gomez: If we add the toggle, we should make it a checkbox with clear copy: "Also revoke existing key after rotation (recommended for compromised keys)". Make recommended state default off but visually call it out.
Samir Patel: Copy nit — current banner says: "This will revoke access" which is ambiguous. Suggest: "Revoking the old key stops all services using it from authenticating immediately." Short version for banner: "Old key will remain active unless you revoke it."
Jamie Ortiz: Focus/order nits: modal open -> focus should go to first form field (name) not CTA. If banner is assertive (aria-live=assertive) it will be announced; but still move keyboard focus sensibly. Also ensure escape closes modal and returns focus to the key row.
Kevin Liu: Tech constraint: if users rotate frequently we want to avoid accidental revokes. So require an extra confirmation only when revoke_old_key = true (small confirm dialog: "Revoke old key? This will immediately cut off services.").
Maya Chen: UX proposal: keep primary CTA "Rotate key" non-danger unless revoke toggle is on, show inline contextual banner under the toggle when turned on, and show a red confirmation dialog on submit if revoke is selected. Also update audit copy to include which user performed revoke.
Samir Patel: +1. Can we also add a tiny help link next to the toggle: "When to revoke?" -> opens docs explaining rotation strategies and queued deployments.
Jamie Ortiz: I'll update the Figma to show the aria-live container and the confirmation flow, and add keyboard flows.
Maya Chen: Thanks — can someone open a ticket for the work items (copy, accessibility, backend flag, docs)?
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-1234: "Key rotate: revoke toggle + accessible warnings + copy updates" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Samir. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1234
Kevin Liu: I'll add the `revoke_old_key` flag to the API (feature-flagged). Will post PR when ready.
Maya Chen: Perfect — let's review the updated Figma and copy in tomorrow's design sync. :thumbsup:
